}}'''Marind''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]] and the son of [[Adan]] and [[Siedre]].{{ref/book|c|Marind}} His story is learned from Rand's [[Visions of Rhuidean|visions]] in the ter'angreal of Rhuidean.

{{Ancestry/Rand}}

== History ==
He was killed by the first arrow of a raider-attack during the wandering of the [[Da'shain Aiel]] in the time of [[Breaking of the World|The Breaking]]. As the last son of Adan, he had a wife called Saralin and two children [[Maigran]] and [[Lewin]] (age of five and six by the time of his death), whom he left for Adan to raise. He had four siblings. [[Elwin]] who starved to death at the age of ten, [[Sorelle]] who died in a fever at the age of twelve, [[Jaren]] who committed suicide at the age of nineteen after he discovered he could channel and [[Rhea]] who was taken by the raiders on the day Marind died. {{ref/book|4|26}}
